description: Reset the plot system. Live this is a view-level operation, not the per-view settings reset the 6.0 manual describes - see the notes.

examples.description: Reset the plot system (see notes - destructive on 6.00)

notes: Only the 6.0 manual documents this command, but it remains in the engine's global plot enumeration on 9.8.

The live semantics differ from the manual and across versions: on 6.00 it closes EVERY open view and recreates the default view (not the documented per-view settings reset); on 9.8 it leaves existing views untouched and opens a fresh default view.
The named form ('plot <s> reset') is rejected on both 6.00 and 9.8.
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on the PFC3D 6.00 and 9.8 GUIs (state grade via the GUI event stream): on 6.00 'plot reset' closed all open views and recreated the default view; on 9.8 it opened a new default view while existing views and their items survived intact.
